topics.title: The Pile Concept
topics.body: 52 Card Pickup presents your photo archive as a randomised pile of physical prints scattered on a surface. Each page load shows a random selection of images with random rotations, positions, and z-index stacking. Click any image to view it. Click Reshuffle (or press R) to throw a new set of prints.

topics.title: Frame Styles
topics.body: The four frame styles this skin was built around — Polaroid, Standard Print, Borderless and Slide Mount — are not currently applied. Their CSS is still in the skin, but the landing page is now drawn by the shared ORGANIZED MAYHEM engine, which renders its own cards and does not assign the frame classes, and there is no frame control in Skin Admin. Photographs appear unframed. If you want the frames back, say so — the styling survives and it is the wiring that is missing, not the design.

topics.title: Pile Settings
topics.body:
The scattered landing page is drawn by ORGANIZED MAYHEM, the shared engine that also drives other scatter layouts, rather than by controls belonging to this skin. How many photographs are dealt, how far they spread, how much they overlap and how much they drift and warp are site-wide settings (mayhem_initial_count, mayhem_max_width, mayhem_overlap_max, mayhem_drift and mayhem_warp), not entries in Skin Admin. Note that they currently have no admin screen of their own, so they are not adjustable from the CMS as it stands.

What this skin's own Skin Admin does control is colour and type: Canvas Background, the header and footer colours, Primary and Secondary Text, Accent Colour, and the title and body fonts, sizes and case.

topics.title: Reshuffle
topics.body: The Reshuffle button (fixed bottom-right) loads a new random set of images via AJAX without a page reload. The current pile fades out, a fresh random set is fetched, and the new pile fades in. The button label is configurable. Press R on the keyboard for the same effect (can be disabled).

topics.title: Single Image View
topics.body: Clicking any image in the pile opens the standard single-image view with title, description, EXIF data, and comments. A "Return to Pile" link navigates back to the landing page, which re-randomises on return — this is intentional. The point is discovery, not navigation.

topics.title: Archive
topics.body: The ARCHIVE link in the nav shows a standard square-thumbnail grid for visitors who want to browse systematically. This is the same archive system used by other SnapSmack skins.
